title: Erase says nothing was deleted after the account was deleted
what: A signed-in member who picks 'erase this phone and delete my account' has the account deleted first. If the phone erase then fails, the message says nothing was deleted, though the account and its saved copy are already gone.
expected: The message says the account was deleted and the phone erase failed, and offers to try the phone erase again.
who: signed-in members who erase their phone and account
how_often: rarely: only when the phone erase fails after the account delete
fix_line: Say what already went when the phone part fails after the account delete
